resources.string: The European PC DVD, as an .iso. It is unpacked on this device; nothing is uploaded.
The English v1.0.1 executable, bare or in a .zip. It is checked against the build this port was made from.

The game is read from plain files, so everything it needs must end up in real storage. The picker above already does that without any permission. Allowing all files access only adds two shortcuts: using an unpacked game folder where it lies, and installing to a folder of your choice. It grants access to the whole shared storage, so it is optional.
All files access not granted. Optional: the picker works without it.
All files access not granted. Tap to review the setting.
In the system screen, allow this app to manage all files, then come back. This screen checks again when you return.
This device has no All Files Access screen. Use the picker instead.
All files access needs Android 11 or newer. Use the picker instead.
This device has no folder picker. Use the disc image instead.
%1$s does not look like an unpacked Virtua Tennis 3 folder: it has no Resource folder.
Folder chosen. It is copied into app storage while installing.
That folder could not be opened. Its permission may have been revoked: pick it again.
The folder chosen earlier is no longer accessible. Pick it again, or use the disc image.
There are no files in that folder.
Choosing another install folder needs all files access. Grant it above, or keep app storage.
Not enough free space there: the install needs about 4.5 GB.

Needs about 4.5 GB free. Keep the app open while it unpacks.
Requires your own copy of Virtua Tennis 3. Unofficial fan port, not affiliated with SEGA.
A preset only fills in defaults: each option above can be changed on its own. Auto follows the device tier and the thermal status. The game\'s own graphics options are untouched.
Resolution and frame rate are set when the renderer starts, so this relaunches the game. Press Back to close without applying.
